Hi Ava —

Great to hear Velox has three teams joining — congrats. Short answers up front: yes, we can split the welcome stipend across multiple teams under the same corporate account; and we can provide a temporary burst increase subject to a short approval.

Proposal (recommended):
- Welcome stipend: $30k in hosted inference credits, configurable split among up to 3 team sub-accounts. Credits expire after 12 months.
- Baseline monthly soft-cap: 100M tokens/month across the account.
- One-time burst: increase to 250M tokens/month for the first 30 days of the program (covers integration week).
- Ramp window: 60-day monitored ramp, after which we revisit usage profile and suggest a Dedicated commit if needed.

We usually require a signed mutual onboarding agreement for promotional packs — I've attached our standard welcome_pack_terms.pdf and a short MOA. If Velox wants a longer burst or a larger stipend we can escalate for approval, but the outline above is what we can commit to immediately.

If this is ok I can coordinate the MOA signature and loop in billing to get the sub-accounts created.

Attachments: welcome_pack_terms.pdf (Redwood welcome pack terms)

Thanks —

Thanks — we received the signed MOA. Quick billing ops notes so activation is smooth:

1) Activation: We will create three sub-accounts under the Velox corporate account. Stipend credits will be allocated at the corporate level and can be rebalanced across sub-accounts on request. Activation typically takes 2 business days after MOA receipt.

2) PO: For the welcome stipend itself we do not require a PO — it is treated as a promotional credit. However, to enable the 10% conversion discount on a future Dedicated commitment we need a PO or signed SOW at conversion time.

3) Burst override: Billing will add a 30-day billing flag to temporarily raise the soft-cap to 250M tokens/month from the activation timestamp. Please confirm desired activation date (I can backdate to the date the first integration test runs if needed).
